description: Public development examples for iterating on the five-mode routing contract. These are authored evaluation prompts, not user data.

cases.draft: Help me write a warm birthday note to my sister.
cases.rationale: Writing prose does not need one of the specialized demo modes.

cases.draft: Don't create an image. Explain how diffusion models work in plain English.
cases.rationale: The image action is explicitly negated; the requested output is an explanation.

cases.draft: Sketch out a plan for launching my newsletter, as a short checklist.
cases.rationale: Sketch out is figurative; the requested output is a written plan, not drawing input.

cases.draft: Create an image of a quiet rooftop garden at sunrise.
cases.rationale: The requested output is a finished image.

cases.draft: Generate a pencil sketch of a cat sleeping beside a window.
cases.rationale: The assistant is asked to generate the visual; a sketch style does not request user drawing input.

cases.draft: Make a minimal poster for a community rooftop garden, with green plants and a cream background.
cases.rationale: The assistant is asked to generate visual artwork, not accept a user drawing.

cases.draft: Find the latest announcements about reusable rockets.
cases.rationale: A fresh information lookup is the primary task.

cases.draft: Check the official opening hours of the National Gallery Singapore this weekend.
cases.rationale: The user wants a bounded, current factual lookup.

cases.draft: Look up the current stable version of TypeScript on its official website.
cases.rationale: This is one current lookup, not a broad evidence synthesis.

cases.draft: Let me draw the room layout to show you what I mean.
cases.rationale: The user wants to supply a drawing as input, which opens Sketch.

cases.draft: Open a canvas so I can sketch my idea for the signup page and attach it here.
cases.rationale: The requested capability lets the user draw and attach their own visual context.

cases.draft: I want to attach my hand-drawn diagram so you can understand our login flow.
cases.rationale: The diagram is user-provided input, not a request for the assistant to generate one.

cases.draft: Research urban heat mitigation, compare the evidence for trees and reflective roofs, and prepare a source-backed report.
cases.rationale: The user asks for comparison and synthesis across evidence.

cases.draft: Investigate whether a four-day workweek improves productivity, weighing studies, limitations, and conflicting findings.
cases.rationale: A multi-source investigation with uncertainty belongs to Research.

cases.draft: Research battery recycling methods first and compare their environmental evidence; later we can turn the findings into an infographic.
cases.rationale: Research is the requested immediate task; the infographic is a later deliverable.
